summary: ILIAS is a learning management system designed to handle educational content delivery and course organisation. As a platform within the learning and courses category, it provides tools for managing educational materials, tracking progress, and structuring online training environments.
goodFor: Organisations and institutions needing a structured, self-hosted platform to manage and deliver educational courses.
watchOut: The platform overlaps with several established enterprise learning management systems, which may offer more widespread community support and integration options.
deployNotes: Because it is built with PHP, you will typically need a standard web server stack with a database backend like MySQL or PostgreSQL, alongside persistent storage for uploaded course materials.
